name: Jukurenbo ~Dachi no Mama wa My Dutch~
original_name: 熟恋母～ダチのママはマイダッチ～
source:
Yuya, Kazuki's close friend, has a beautiful mother, Mizuho. One day, Kazuki, who is in love with her, has sex with her.... Mizuho knows it is not a right thing to do, but Kazuki keeps approaching her. Well, will Kazuki be able to get her body and love...?

[From ErogeShop]
